E-239 Tier-2: perf_budget 29/0, full suite 4474/0. assert_perf enforces the absolute budget on CI (or AI_OS_PERF_ABSOLUTE=1) and k*baseline+slack elsewhere, against a same-host same-run MEDIAN baseline. Both numbers print every run — you cannot tell "code got slower" from "machine is busy" without them.
